rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an educational institution, including primary and secondary schools and specialized schools when the type is specified.

example.english: This school has lots of extracurricular activities.
example.traditional: 呢間學校有好多課外活動。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 jau5 hou2 do1 fo3 ngoi6 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this only when the educational institution is a university or other place of tertiary education.

example.english: My younger sister is going to university next year to start school and study medicine.
example.traditional: 我妹下年會去大學讀醫科。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui6 haa6 nin4 wui5 heoi3 daai6 hok6 duk6 ji1 fo1

rows.note: Use this for a school or group of fish and similar marine animals.

example.english: While diving, I saw a school of fish swimming past the coral reef.
example.traditional: 潛水嗰陣，我見到魚群喺珊瑚礁附近游過。
example.jyutping: cim4 seoi2 go2 zan6 ngo5 gin3 dou2 jyu4 kwan4 hai2 saan1 wu4 ziu1 fu6 gan6 jau4 gwo3

rows.note: Use this for the period when classes are in session, rather than for the separate after-school part of the English example.

example.english: You can't use your phone during school hours.
example.traditional: 上堂時間唔可以用手機。
example.jyutping: soeng5 tong4 si4 gaan3 m4 ho2 ji5 jung6 sau2 gei1
